name: Fuji Kaito
source: A trend-chasing social media enthusiast, Kaito works hard to fit in with the Frostheim elites despite his modest upbringing, but his efforts are overshadowed by his tendency to be a gutless coward. Currently looking for a girlfriend (please spread the word.)
